segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאוֹמֵר לְאִשָּׁה ״הִתְקַדְּשִׁי לִי בִּתְמָרָה זוֹ״, ״הִתְקַדְּשִׁי לִי בָּזוֹ״ אִם יֵשׁ בְּאַחַת מֵהֶן שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה – מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת, וְאִם לָאו – אֵינָהּ מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת. ״בָּזוֹ וּבָזוֹ וּבָזוֹ״ אִם יֵשׁ שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה בְּכוּלָּן – מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת, וְאִם לָאו – אֵינָהּ מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת. הָיְתָה אוֹכֶלֶת רִאשׁוֹנָה רִאשׁוֹנָה – אֵינָהּ מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת, עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בְּאַחַת מֵהֶן שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who says to a woman: Be betrothed to me with this date,» and adds: «Be betrothed to me with that» one, then «if one of» the dates «is worth one peruta she is betrothed, but if not, she is not betrothed,» since he mentioned betrothal in connection with each date. But if he said: Be betrothed to me «with this» one, «and with this» one, «and with this» one, then even «if all of them» together «are worth one peruta she is betrothed, but if not, she is not betrothed.» If he gave her dates with the intention of betrothing her with them, and «she was eating» them «one by one» as she received them, «she is not betrothed unless one of them is worth one peruta.»

moves.cueHe: האומר לאשה התקדשי לי בתמרה זו

moves.summary: if eaten one by one, one must be worth a peruta

positions.claim: repeating 'be betrothed' requires one date worth a peruta; 'with this and this' combines; if she eats them one by one, one must be worth a peruta
